subject: Location request — Llandough-juxta-Penarth parish, vestry and tithe records — Great House / Ty Mawr — not a viewing request
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Glamorgan Archives,

Location request only. I am not asking to book a screen room.

Property: Great House Farm / Ty Mawr, Llandough-juxta-Penarth (not Llandough-juxta-Cowbridge). Working description, not a finding: two parcels; Mary Williams owned the house and garden parcel.

Please state whether you hold, and if so the series, accession, box, shelf and CALM reference, for:
1. Llandough-juxta-Penarth vestry minutes and churchwardens' accounts covering 1870–1930 that name Great House, Ty Mawr, or a Williams occupier or owner;
2. the tithe apportionment and map for the parish, and the plot number or numbers for that holding;
3. any enclosure award for the parish that names the holding.

Please also say whether staff have physically checked that the item is in the stated place (who, date, store). If not held, name the systems searched and whether a physical file was retrieved.

This is a request for recorded information under the Freedom of Information Act 2000, s.1 and s.16.

Requester
